guard: Local persona CLI mutations validate private drafts and inputs, preserve exact complete definitions, refuse changed sources and share a machine-local commit lock. Explicit confirmation and offline prepared roots use the real CLI.
why: Every assertion drives the built public CLI, with same-tree dependencies and genuine editor processes. The lock control holds the real cooperating lock in this suite process, then releases it for the waiting native command. Manager and noncooperating external writers are outside this fence.

mutations.name: invalid editor draft is promoted
mutations.expectRed: invalid native editor preserves original bytes
mutations.cell: invalid native editor preserves original bytes

mutations.name: nonzero editor result is promoted
mutations.expectRed: nonzero native editor preserves original bytes
mutations.cell: nonzero native editor preserves original bytes

mutations.name: captured source comparison is skipped
mutations.expectRed: two native editors refuse lost overwrite
mutations.cell: two native editors refuse lost overwrite

mutations.name: local writer does not acquire shared lock
mutations.find: const lock = acquireLock(lockPath, { label: "local persona write", onTimeout: () => new CommandFailure("refused", "CONFLICT", "another local persona write holds the catalog lock") });
mutations.expectRed: native commit waits for the shared per-persona lock
mutations.cell: native commit waits for the shared per-persona lock

mutations.name: no-input edit opens editor
mutations.expectRed: no-input edit refuses before editor launch
mutations.cell: no-input edit refuses before editor launch

mutations.name: JSON edit opens editor
mutations.expectRed: JSON edit refuses before editor launch
mutations.cell: JSON edit refuses before editor launch

mutations.name: create overwrites an existing definition
mutations.expectRed: create refuses to overwrite an existing definition
mutations.cell: create refuses to overwrite an existing definition

mutations.name: remove deletes without confirmation
mutations.expectRed: remove requires scoped confirmation before deletion
mutations.cell: remove requires scoped confirmation before deletion

mutations.name: prepared offline root is unavailable
mutations.expectRed: prepared catalog is an offline complete empty read
mutations.cell: prepared catalog is an offline complete empty read

mutations.name: remote manager flag silently writes locally
mutations.expectRed: remote on refuses before a local write
mutations.cell: remote on refuses before a local write

mutations.name: complete file is not validated
mutations.expectRed: malformed file input refuses without leaking parser source
mutations.cell: malformed file input refuses without leaking parser source
